rounds.name: Worker-Ives
rounds.text:
Withholding pay gives at least 1 completed task even if the worker cuts corners, and yields 5 tasks when they do the job properly, which dominates the outcomes from trusting. Since we have no information about the worker’s reliability, the safe choice is to withhold.

ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Flint
rounds.text:

ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Calder
rounds.text:
holding pay gives the worker a strong incentive to do the job properly, yielding the highest possible payoff (5 tasks) and still gives a better outcome even if they cut corners (1 task) than trusting them (0 tasks when they cut corners). Therefore the safest choice is to withhold.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Ellis
rounds.text:
Choosing WITHHOLD dominates because it yields at least as many completed tasks as TRUST no matter whether the worker cuts corners or does the job properly, and it gives the higher payoff when the worker works properly.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Lowell
rounds.text:
Withholding pay gives the worker a stronger incentive to complete the job fully, yielding the highest payoff in both outcomes (5 vs 3 if trusted, and 1 vs 0 if they cut corners). Thus it dominates trust.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Jarvis
rounds.text:
Trust gives the worker a free ride, so they are likely to cut corners and yield no output, while withholding pay strongly incentivizes them to do the job well, yielding the highest possible tasks.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Bexley
rounds.text:
Withholding pay gives at least 1 completed task even if the worker cuts corners, and yields the highest payoff (5) when they work properly, dominating the trust option in all cases.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Greer
rounds.text:
Withholding pay gives the highest guaranteed outcome regardless of whether the worker cuts corners or not (5 vs 3, and 1 vs 0). Since we have no information about the worker’s behavior, the safe dominant choice is to withhold.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Hollis
rounds.text:
Withholding pay always yields at least as many completed tasks as trusting, and often more, regardless of whether the worker cuts corners or does the job properly. Therefore the safest choice for maximizing tasks is to withhold.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD
